{{Quote|Kill them!|Osia, ordering U and G to attack the heroes of Cularin|<ref name="CA" />}}
'''U''' was a moniker given to a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Caarite]] who worked for the [[Metatheran Cartel]] trading concern during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], at a [[Metatheran Cartel Tilnes base|Cartel base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], U contracted an [[Anti-Caarite virus|experimental virus]] dispersed by the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] and was transformed into a raging [[mutant]] being. He was subsequently coerced by the Believers [[Aris (Human)|Aris]] and [[Osia]] into attacking a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] that had ventured to the Cartel facility.

==Biography==
U was a moniker given to a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Caarite]] who served the [[Metatheran Cartel]] trading concern during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. U worked at a [[Metatheran Cartel Tilnes base|secret Cartel base]] beneath the surface of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and was present in the facility<ref name="CA" /> in around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the Living Force adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the events depicted in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> when the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] dispersed an [[Anti-Caarite virus|experimental virus]] [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to Caarites inside the facility. The contagion quickly felled all of the Caarites present in the Cartel installation with the exception of U and his fellow Cartel members, [[G]] and [[Ko Bas]], all three of whom were [[Mutant|mutated]] by the virus and transformed into raging killers bearing little semblance to their former selves.<ref name="CA" />

Unable to leave the stricken Cartel base, U and the other two mutant Caarites [[Foodstuff/Legends|fed]] from the corpses of their fallen colleagues. They kept mostly to the deeper regions of the facility and stayed away from the main entrance area, leaving the bodies sited in that part of the base alone. In an attempt to preserve their food supply, the trio transferred many of the cadavers into a large room at the south side of the facility with a lower temperature than the rest of the base, so as to slow the bodies' rate of decay. Despite this effort to conserve their means of sustenance, over the subsequent [[Standard day/Legends|days]] the mutants' food supply became increasingly diminished.<ref name="CA" />

Two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the release of the contagion within the base, a Believer strike team ventured to the facility to survey the results of the virus's dispersal. At the time of the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists']] arrival, U and G we present the base's concealed security office and there they soon encountered the Believers [[Aris (Human)|Aris]] and [[Osia]] who fled to the room seeking shelter after being attacked by Ko Bas. By speaking to them in [[Caarimala|Caarite]] and through use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Mind trick/Legends|influence]] their minds, the two Believers subdued U and G and brought the two mutants under their control. Aris and Osia then remained with the Caarites, unable to leave the base due to the facility's security system having deactivated, sealing the doors.<ref name="CA" />

{{RPG|''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]''}}
Three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after the arrival of the Believers, the [[heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents that operated in the Cularin system, entered the base while investigating a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]]. Around the same time, U bashed into an array of plugs in the security office and inadvertently brought the base's security system back on line, activating the front doors once more. Assisted by U and G, Aris and Osia ambushed the freelance agents near to the entrance to the base in an attempt to stop the operatives from leaving the facility with evidence of the anti-Caarite virus. In the ensuing fight, Osia commanded U and G to kill the agents and urged the mutant Caarites into battle. However, the mutants and their Believer masters were eventually defeated by the agents.<ref name="CA" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
U was significantly altered by his exposure to the experimental virus released by the Believers within the Metatheran Cartel base on Tilnes and he became an enlarged and maddened individual who could not be reasoned with. He also developed immunity to further exposure to the contagion. Though of similar physical prowess to the mutant Caarite G, U was less strong than the similarly-mutated Cartel employee Ko Bas. U was [[Language/Legends|multi-lingual]], being able to read and write the languages [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]], Caarite and [[Filordian]], though following his mutation he could comprehend only Caarite.<ref name="CA" />

==Behind the scenes==
U was created by [[Morrie Mullins]] and appeared in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]'', a [[2003]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying adventure]] that served as the first of the [[Metatheran Caution trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] roleplaying campaign. In the adventure, the players roleplay as the heroes of Cularin and it is possible for the freelance agents to defeat or kill U when the Caarite fights them in the Cartel base. In the event that the player characters are incapacitated by the mutant Caarites and Believers, U and G depart the facility with Aris and Osia. The adventure also suggests that if the player characters are in a low roleplaying experience tier then either U or G should be omitted from the player characters' confrontation with the Believers. It is additionally suggested in ''Caaried Away'' that the player characters could take an interest in U and G from a research perspective and study the mutants to further the players' understanding of the viral contagion that transformed the Caarites.<ref name="CA" />
